name: Suffusion of Essence lengthens Suffuse by 2 seconds per Demonfire consumed (#1280)
contract: #1280: Suffusion of Essence 706566 (family 23, CharacterAdvancement 34075, class 17 ability option) reads 'Increases the duration of Suffuse by $/1000;s1 sec for each Demonfire consumed' with s1 = 2000 (BasePoints 1999 + DieSides 1). Its effect 0 is the native aura 107 SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (MiscValue 23) on mask (0, 0, 0x80000000), which matches only Demonfire 500906 (flags (0, 0x10, 0x80000000)); Demonfire's effect 2 is 3000 (BasePoints 2999 + DieSides 1). Suffuse 801063 reads 'Lasts $/1000;500906s3 sec for each Demonfire consumed', so the per-Demonfire duration is Demonfire's effect 2 value including the caster's modifiers: 3 s, or 5 s with Suffusion of Essence. AscensionXorothContracts.cpp turns Demonfire's effects into dummies and xoroth_casts::OnCalcMaxDuration sets the Suffuse auras (801063, whose effect 2 carries Speed Demon, and the heal-over-time 801064) to a literal 3000 ms per consumed Demonfire, so before the fix the talent changed nothing. Expected: with 3 Demonfire consumed, both Suffuse auras last 9 s untalented and 15 s with the talent (9 s before the fix). The talented cast clears the first cast's auras first so the durations are freshly calculated.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Demonfire's effect 2 (Suffuse seconds per Demonfire) is 3000 ms
Three Demonfire stacks for the untalented Suffuse
SETUP: the untalented Suffuse heal-over-time is up
BASELINE: 3 Demonfire give a 9 s heal-over-time
BASELINE: 3 Demonfire give a 9 s Suffuse aura
Force the Suffusion of Essence passive aura
SETUP: the Suffusion of Essence passive is active
SETUP: the talent raises Demonfire's effect 2 to 5000 ms
Clear the global cooldown from the first Suffuse cast
The same three Demonfire stacks for the talented Suffuse
SETUP: the talented Suffuse heal-over-time is up
CONTRACT: 3 Demonfire give a 15 s heal-over-time (5 s each)
CONTRACT: 3 Demonfire give a 15 s Suffuse aura (5 s each)
